instruction: I need to add speaker notes to my presentation but the Notes panel is hidden. Please show the Notes panel at the bottom so I can write my presentation notes.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(2)

metadata.explanation: Task requires user to show the Notes panel in LibreOffice Impress. Evaluator checks accessibility tree for Notes panel/text elements.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies that the Notes panel is shown in LibreOffice Impress
Uses role-based checking (elem.attrib.get('role', '')) which is the correct approach for accessibility tree parsing - previous tag-based issue has been fixed
Checks 'showing' state to ensure the panel is not just present but actually visible, which correctly verifies the instruction requirement
Name-based search for 'Notes' or 'Note' is appropriate and covers the expected element naming
Role list is comprehensive and includes variants like 'scroll pane' (with space) and 'scroll-pane' (with hyphen)
Error handling is present and robust
No postconfig needed - accessibility tree can be read directly after task completion
